## Summary

I implemented the experimental `ChatAnthropicTools` module in the LangChain Anthropic partner package.

### Files created/modified (source only — no `tests/` touched)

**1. `libs/partners/anthropic/langchain_anthropic/experimental.py`** (new)
- `ChatAnthropicTools` subclasses `ChatAnthropic`, so it inherits all standard operations (`stream`/`astream`/`batch`/`abatch`/`invoke`/`ainvoke`), accepts `model_name` + `config`, and works in prompt chains with system messages — all returning string-content messages.
- `bind_tools(tools)` — converts each tool to OpenAI function format via `convert_to_openai_tool(...)["function"]` and binds them under a `tools` kwarg using `super().bind(tools=...)`.
- `_format_params(...)` — injects tool descriptions into the system prompt as XML wrapped in a `<tools>` tag (prepending to any existing system message).
- `with_structured_output(schema)` — accepts a Pydantic `BaseModel` (or dict), returns a `Runnable` chain (`bind_tools | PydanticToolsParser`) that yields a correctly typed model instance; dicts route through `JsonOutputKeyToolsParser`.
- `_format_output(data, **kwargs)` — parses XML `<function_calls>` responses, sets message content to `""`, and places parsed calls in `additional_kwargs["tool_calls"]` as dicts with `type` and `function` keys.
- A `root_validator` raises `ImportError` with install instructions if `defusedxml` is missing; XML is parsed via `defusedxml.ElementTree`.

**3. `libs/partners/anthropic/pyproject.toml`**
- Added `defusedxml` as an optional dependency (with a `tools` extra) and to the test group so tests can run.
